findings.title: Restore release blocking for failed adversarial reviews
findings.problem: The workflow removes adversary outcome enforcement and invokes `seo:enforce -- --advisory`, which succeeds even when a valid review contains release blockers. This bypasses the required accuracy gate for public content. The owner-amendment assertion added to CLAUDE.md in this same change does not establish authorization to override the project rules supplied for this review.
findings.failure_scenario: A public page introduces an incorrect NCLEX claim or clinical explanation that passes deterministic checks. The adversarial review returns FAIL with a release blocker, but its step uses continue-on-error and advisory enforcement returns success. The workflow can therefore pass with the identified error unresolved.
findings.fix: Restore strict `seo:enforce` execution and the explicit successful adversary outcome requirement. Remove the conflicting public-content exemption and update the tests to require failed adversarial verdicts to block release.

assessment: Do not merge. The change makes failed adversarial content reviews non-blocking, contradicting the supplied rule that adversarial AI approval gates all site content, including public copy.
